records.public_safe_text: on the listed date and time, police responded to a major accident involving a motor vehicle and a pedestrian on a public roadway. upon arrival i saw ems on the scene attending to pedestrian on a stretcher. as i approached the scene, i saw unit 1 parked in the parking lot of the whataburger restaurant. i contacted the pedestrian who was being attended to by the ems technicians on scene. i observed injuries to pedestrian's right knee, left leg, and hematoma on his forehead. i asked him what happened and he stated that he was walking on [roadway] onto san pedro when unit 1 struck him. pedestrian stated that what he remembered next was that he was on the ground. i then went over to where unit 1 driver was standing and asked her to tell me what happened. unit 1 stated that she had the green light and didn't see the pedestrian when she made the left turn. unit 1 stated she thinks she hit pedestrian with her drivers side mirror because her left side mirror was broken. i asked for units 1's drivers license and proof of liability insurance. unit 1 produced a texas identification card and was unable to provide me with a valid proof of insurance upon demand. unit 1 was given a citation for driving without proof of financial responsibility and operating a motor vehicle without a valid license. since unit 1 was unable to provide proof of financial responsibility,i requested for the service of a contract wrecker to tow unit 1's vehicle to the pound. i provided pedestrian with a [case id] on sapd form dar 12 (crash information sheet) [medical facility]. no further police action was taken. coban and bwc were activated for review.

records.public_safe_text: unit 2 said that he was in the parking lot of 4654 rigsby. he was behind his parked car removing items from the bed of his vehicle when unit 1 drove by at a high rate of speed and the rear view mirror struck him in the right shoulder. he said it hit him so hard it spun his body around to face the opposite direction. he said the driver stopped and said he was sorry, that he did not mean to hit him, but then continued through the lot without giving unit 2 any information or rendering [medical facility] at the time of this report and had the use of his hand and fingers. he did not call at the scene or time of the crash, because he said his phone had to be fixed. he was able to move his arm up and down and back and forth while we were speaking but complained of pain in his shoulder. i advised him to follow up with a doctor and to save the paperwork the doctor gives him. he was given this [case id] and the number to traffic investigations in order to follow up with criminal charges. an afr report for failure to stop and render aid has been generated under this same [case id]. on [date] the driver of the secon unit called to give his side of the story. he said that on the listed day he was pulling forwards and heard a thunk. he stopped and saw unit 2 rubbing his shoulder from his right mirror. he backed up, rolled down the passenger window and asked what happened. he asked if i hit you i'm sorry, and asked several times if he was alright. he told him i didn't know i hit you but if i did i didn't do it on purpose. he said that the man never answered, never spoke to say if he was hurt, and finally he drove away. he said that as he was leaving he looked back to see if unit 2 was taking his plate down, and said it looked as though he wasn't. he said weeks later he got a call from his insurance, so he was wanting to call police to make sure. he said that he stopped right after hearing the noise, and when he looked back even though unit 1 was rubbing his shoulder he was nowhere near his vehicle. unit 1 was given this [case id] and advised to contact his insurance.

records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to respond to a call for a possible injured sick person seen laying in a sidewalk at the above listed location. upon making the location, officer a. uriegas #0043 advised me that v1 had no pulse. when i approached v1, her body was positioned on the sidewalk in a fetal position on her right side with a small stream of blood on the back of [roadway] and a small pool of blood by the front of her face. v1 had a sweater in both the number one and two lanes with a shoe laying a short distance away in the grass area. i was not able to identify v1 fully but was able to find a via bus pass with her name on it. there was a side rearview [roadway] ([roadway]) with glass from the mirror scattered in both lanes. there was also a plastic cover from sp1's vehicle. emergency medical services medic 24 was dispatched to make the location for v1. when ems arrived on the scene, they proceeded to try and revive v1. sup was then notified, along with cs and det to process the scene. tid stated they will make the location to process the scene. sup made the scene shortly after being notified. there were no known witnesses of vehicle description at the scene. v1 was pronounced deceased by k. cyrus #780 at 0250 hours. mxe was notified and made the location to examine v1. mxe took custody of v1. cs processed the scene and tid release the scene. det was informed there might be possible video surveillance at 11530 ih-35 n (firstmark credit union). the adjacent hotel was contacted and advised their video surveillance would be made available the next day by a supervisor for 11526 ih-35 n. coban and body worn camera made available upon request. this crash report has been updated on [date] by detective c. pelkey #2012 with the pedestrian's information and the vehicle information.
